arms.name: random_scaled_ema
arms.purpose: conservative allocation control receives one additional step and greater cost

execution.sparse_arms: dense forward with gathered 50% FFN backward and inverse-activity scale 2
execution.ema: identical final 0.95 EMA for every arm with no decay sweep or checkpoint selection
execution.deployment: ordinary dense inference with averaged weights

step_pricing.source: realized active fractions in results-update/dev-body6/low_max_abs_update_seed9406.json and the identical pregenerated batch stream
step_pricing.rule: for each step, recompute valid tokens and exact active counts, then apply the CPU-calibrated dense-minus-inactive-backward formula plus program scoring, gather/scatter, scale multiplications, and EMA overhead

primary_endpoint: final EMA ordinary dense held-out loss at training-plus-scaling-plus-EMA cost

decision_rules.allocation_failure: low_max_abs does not beat random despite random receiving more steps and cost; stop
decision_rules.no_level_3: low_max_abs beats random but not dense EMA; stop
decision_rules.development_level_3: low_max_abs EMA loss is below random and dense EMA while total cost is no greater than either
decision_rules.confirmation: only development_level_3 launches the identical body-7 comparison

prohibited: changing steps, activity, scale, batch size, EMA decay, or evaluation after launch
using the failed larger-batch, attention, or anchor variants
launching body 7 without a development-level win
